title: check_tfs.py: also check plugin dissectors.
description:
I remember there was a comment about the linkage not working on
Windows, so will try this before fixing all of the places where
it looks as though the common definitions could be used.

notes.body:
This did fail, where Windows won't accept that the external symbol is really const somehow?
Will leave in case someone has input, but think this change needs to be abandoned.  Presumably we don't want to make TFS work with non-const structs just for plugins...

Hi,
If i remember correctly it has something to do with accessing memory in different dlls or something like that.
Bottom line is that tfs's must be locally defined in plugins.
Regards
Anders
